message.content:
In the discussion about the game Red Dead Redemption 2, Fionnuala shared a humorous glitch she encountered during her gameplay. Specifically, she mentioned that one time, she was on a mission, and Arthur ended up floating in mid-air after a cutscene. Instead of dying, Arthur just hung there for a solid minute before dropping down like nothing happened! This moment broke the tension of the moment and had Fionnuala cracking up. 

This type of glitch, where Arthur (or the player character) floats in mid-air without dying, is a common occurrence in open-world games and often leads to amusing situations.
